name: Sunway Healthcare Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Sunway Healthcare 在马来西亚交易所主板完成首次公开募股（IPO），并围绕医疗中心网络推进多项扩张：收购 Sunway Medical Centre Velocity 的 Tower A、槟城 Seberang Jaya 物业及 Seremban、Iskandar Puteri 的土地，同时与 Putrajaya Holdings 成立合资公司以开发 Sunway Medical Centre Putrajaya。
overview_en: In 2026, Sunway Healthcare completed its initial public offering (IPO) on the Main Market of Bursa Malaysia and pursued several expansions across its medical centre network: acquiring Tower A of Sunway Medical Centre Velocity, the Sunway Hotel Seberang Jaya property in Penang, and land in Seremban and Iskandar Puteri, while forming a joint venture with Putrajaya Holdings to develop Sunway Medical Centre Putrajaya.

segments.name: 医疗中心及设施
segments.note: 今年通过收购物业和土地扩大医疗中心网络，并推进 Putrajaya 新医疗中心的合资开发。
segments.note_en: This year, the segment expanded its medical centre network through property and land acquisitions, and advanced the joint-venture development of a new medical centre in Putrajaya.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司 Sunway Medical 3C4 与 Sunway Integrated Properties 签订买卖协议，收购 Sunway Medical Centre Velocity 的 Tower A（22层中的低12层，即地面层至10楼，包括一个夹层）。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary Sunway Medical 3C4 entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Sunway Integrated Properties to acquire Tower A of Sunway Medical Centre Velocity (the lower 12 of 22 floors, i.e. ground floor to 10th floor, including one mezzanine).

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Sunway Healthcare Ventures 与 Tapak Senja 签订合资及股东协议，以开发 Sunway Medical Centre Putrajaya。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Sunway Healthcare Ventures entered into a joint venture and shareholders agreement with Tapak Senja to develop Sunway Medical Centre Putrajaya.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Sunway Medical Centre Penang 与 RHB Trustees（Sunway REIT 受托人）签订补充协议，以 RM60.0 million 现金收购 Sunway Hotel Seberang Jaya 物业。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Sunway Medical Centre Penang entered into a supplemental agreement with RHB Trustees (trustee of Sunway REIT) to acquire the Sunway Hotel Seberang Jaya property for a total cash consideration of RM60.0 million.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 99.9% 子公司 Sunway Medical Centre 与 Sunway Sentral Seremban 签订买卖协议，收购 Seremban 一幅约 2.1 英亩的永久地契土地。
actions.text_en: 99.9%-owned subsidiary Sunway Medical Centre entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Sunway Sentral Seremban to acquire a parcel of freehold land measuring approximately 2.1 acres in Seremban.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 99.9% 子公司 Sunway Medical Centre 与 Sunway Marketplace、Sunway Parkview 及 Sunway Iskandar 签订买卖协议，收购位于 Sunway City Iskandar Puteri 的四幅永久地契土地，总面积约 9.918 英亩。
actions.text_en: 99.9%-owned subsidiary Sunway Medical Centre entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Sunway Marketplace, Sunway Parkview and Sunway Iskandar to acquire four parcels of freehold land measuring in aggregate approximately 9.918 acres at Sunway City Iskand…

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 99.9% 子公司 Sunway Medical Centre 接受 Sunway Sentral Seremban 的献议书，以收购 Seremban 一幅约 2.1 英亩的永久地契土地。
actions.text_en: 99.9%-owned subsidiary Sunway Medical Centre accepted a letter of offer from Sunway Sentral Seremban to acquire a parcel of freehold land measuring approximately 2.1 acres in Seremban.
